# Committee notes, 6 November

Present: Jonas (secretary), Ana, Mr. Lindqvist.

## Water shutoff

- Brightwater Plumbing replaces the main valve in the basement on Tuesday
  18 November. Water goes off for the whole building at 9:00.
- Hot water too: the boiler has to be switched off while the valve is out.
  Heating is on a separate circuit and stays on.
- End time: their foreman said "mid-afternoon, probably by three, but it
  depends on what we find once the old valve is out." Not confirmed. Jonas
  will post on the noticeboard when the water is back.
- Why: the old valve leaked in October and flooded the basement storage. The
  insurer wants it replaced before they renew the policy in December.
- Tenants don't need to do anything to their own taps or pipes.
- Ana's tips: fill a few bottles and the kettle the night before, keep a
  bucket of water for flushing, don't start the washing machine or the
  dishwasher that morning.
- When the water comes back, it may run brown or cloudy for a minute. Run the
  cold tap in the kitchen until it's clear. The pipes may bang for a while
  because of air in them.
- Anyone who needs water that day for medical reasons, or who can't carry
  water, should tell Jonas by Friday 14 November. Ana can bring water up.
- Basement storage stays locked all day. Don't leave anything in the corridor
  down there.
- Jonas: flat 3B, 0176 555 0142, jonas.linden3b@example.org.
- Brightwater asked tenants not to call them. All questions go to Jonas.

## Other

- Bike room lock: Mr. Lindqvist gets quotes.
- Summer party: next meeting.

content.text:
**Before you send this:** in 2026, 18 November is a Wednesday and 14 November is a Saturday. The notes say "Tuesday 18 November" and "Friday 14 November", which match 2025. I've kept the dates as the notes give them, so please check both with Brightwater before this goes out.

---

**Subject: Water off all day on Tuesday 18 November**

Dear neighbours,

**On Tuesday 18 November, the whole building will have no water from 9:00.** This means both cold and hot water.

**Why:** In October the old main valve in the basement leaked and flooded the basement storage. Brightwater Plumbing is replacing it. Our insurer wants this done before they renew the building's policy in December.

**When it will be back:** We don't know for sure yet. The plumbers expect mid-afternoon, probably by 15:00. It could take longer, depending on what they find once the old valve is out. I'll post on the noticeboard as soon as the water is back.

**Heating stays on.** It runs on a separate circuit. The boiler will be off while the work is done, so there will be no hot water.

**You don't need to do anything to your own taps or pipes.**

**To get ready, the night before:**
- Fill a few bottles with drinking water, and fill your kettle.
- Keep a bucket of water for flushing the toilet.
- Don't start the washing machine or dishwasher that morning.

**When the water comes back:**
- The water may run brown or cloudy for a minute. Run the cold kitchen tap until it's clear.
- The pipes may bang for a while because of air in them. This is normal.

**If you need help:** Please tell me by **Friday 14 November** if you need water that day for medical reasons, or if you can't carry water yourself. Ana can bring water up to your flat.

**Basement:** Basement storage will be locked all day. Please don't leave anything in the basement corridor.

**Questions:** Please contact me, not Brightwater. They have asked tenants not to call them.

Thank you for your patience. This repair should keep the basement from flooding again.

Jonas
Secretary, Linden Court Residents' Committee
Flat 3B · 0176 555 0142 · jonas.linden3b@example.org
